Senior Match-3 Designer, New Game
raw.description:
We’re looking for a talented and highly experienced Senior Match-3 Designer (internally Game Designer) to join our lovely and ambitious game team and help craft fun, rewarding and memorable puzzle experiences for our cozy mobile game.

You’ll own the overall match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define how the puzzle game feels to play while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar.

You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience.

As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels.

  • Collaborate with developers to tune game feel and match 3 gameplay to be best-in-class

  • Own the design of blockers, boosters and rewards and shape satisfying level progression

  • Use analytics, player feedback and playtesting to continuously refine levels and improve player experience.

  • Work alongside Engineering to improve level design tools, workflows and implementation processes.

  • Partner with Art to ensure levels are visually readable, aesthetically cohesive and support the game’s creative vision.

  • Plan and own Match 3 content production, ensuring a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that supports development milestones and LiveOps.

    • Lead external level design contractors and outsourcing partners by providing clear briefs, regular feedback and quality reviews, ensuring all delivered content meets Treefrog’s standards.

  • Mentor other designers through feedback, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving.

What You Have

  • Experience shipping successful free-to-play match-3 or puzzle games.

  • Experience designing LiveOps events, seasonal content or limited-time game modes.

  • Strong understanding of player progression, retention, engagement and monetisation in puzzle.

  • Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows.

  • Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers.

  • Have a deep understanding of the competition and genre trends.

  • Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences.

What We're Looking for

  • A strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive work forward autonomously.

  • A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals.

  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and solve problems.

  • Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency.

  • The ability to lead external partners with clarity, empathy and high standards.

  • A collaborative approach to sharing knowledge, mentoring designers and raising the team’s quality bar.

  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to constructively challenge decisions.

  • A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals.

  • A commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and positive team culture.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our London office. The team values in-person collaboration and typically works from the office three days a week: Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

Not Sure if You Should Apply?

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

raw.title: Director, Customer Success
raw.description:
CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth trusted by more than 1,300 global brands and agencies.

We’re on a mission to make businesses more human, and humans more impactful. We operate by our values — be intentional, pursue excellence every day, embrace the journey together, and be a good human — every day. CreatorIQ has earned the title of best companies to work for in multiple programs, including BuiltIn LA and NY. It’s been named a Fastest-Growing Company in North America on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ for four years, was named a leader in IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Influencer Marketing Platforms for Large Enterprises in 2025, was named a Leader by The Forrester New Wave™: Influencer Marketing Solutions, and has been consistently recognized by G2 as a Leader, and is rated 5 stars on Influencer MarketingHub. We operate in a flexible work model that combines both in-person and remote work to boost collaboration, enhance innovation, and adapt to individual work styles.

We're seeking passionate, innovative minds to join our journey. Be a part of our dynamic team and let's transform the industry together!

Director, Customer Success (EMEA)

As our EMEA Customer Success organization continues to evolve, we're looking for a strategic and commercially minded Customer Success leader to help shape the next phase of growth for our customers, team, and business.

As Director, Customer Success, you'll lead a team of Customer Success Professionals while helping some of the world's leading brands maximize the value of CreatorIQ. You'll bring a combination of Customer Success leadership, enterprise commercial expertise, and creator marketing knowledge to drive retention, growth, and long-term partnership success across EMEA. As a member of the EMEA Customer Success leadership team, you'll own portfolio performance, forecasting, strategic customer engagement, team development, and operational excellence while helping shape the future of Customer Success at CreatorIQ.

Location: London, UK (Hybrid, 3 days per week in office)

Travel: Approximately 20% travel across EMEA customer locations.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Customer Success Professionals while fostering a culture of accountability, performance, and customer-centricity.

  • Own portfolio performance across EMEA, driving customer retention, growth, forecasting accuracy, risk mitigation, and long-term customer success.

  • Build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders and help enterprise brands maximize the impact and maturity of their creator marketing programs.

  • Partner closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, Professional Services, and Support to advocate for customer needs and influence strategic business outcomes.

  • Apply industry knowledge and market insights to help customers evolve their creator marketing strategies and achieve measurable business outcomes.

  • Serve as a senior leader within the EMEA organization, driving escalations, operational priorities, organizational development, and cross-functional initiatives.

Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

  • 8+ years of experience leading Enterprise Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, or related customer-facing teams within SaaS, MarTech, AdTech, Social Media Technology, or Creator Marketing organizations.

  • Proven experience leading Enterprise Customer Success or Strategic Account teams with responsibility for retention, renewals, expansion, customer growth, and portfolio performance.

  • Demonstrated success developing and leading high-performing Customer Success Professionals and Managers while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Strong executive presence with experience advising senior stakeholders, including CMOs, Heads of Influencer Marketing, Heads of Social, VPs, and other senior business leaders.

  • Strong commercial acumen with ownership of retention, revenue growth, forecasting, and strategic customer outcomes.

  • Experience managing strategic enterprise customer relationships, executive business reviews, complex escalations, and high-impact customer risk situations.

  • Ability to independently lead cross-functional initiatives and influence outcomes across Sales, Product, Marketing, Professional Services, and Support teams.

  • Direct experience within influencer marketing, creator economy, creator technology, social media technology, MarTech, or a closely related industry strongly preferred. Candidates from creator marketing platforms, social/creator agencies, or brand-side creator marketing organizations are especially encouraged to apply.

  • Demonstrated understanding of creator marketing trends, influencer strategy, measurement frameworks, and the evolving creator economy landscape.

  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and experience leveraging AI tools to improve productivity, customer insights, forecasting, operational efficiency, and customer engagement.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Passionate about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply! CreatorIQ is a place where everyone can grow.

What you will get from us:

  • People: work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do.

  • Guidance: utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you’ll need to become successful here from your first day with us.

  • Work/life harmony: 25 days vacation, floating and set holidays, wellness allowance, and paid parental leave.

  • Stock options as part of our equity-sharing program.

  • Healthcare coverage, encompassing mental health, physical therapies, dental, vision, cancer coverage, and more.

  • Comprehensive perks program providing stipends for wellness, cell phone and internet, home office setup, mental wellness, professional development, plus occasional company-funded meal opportunities throughout the year.

Who we are:

CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth. Trusted by more than 1,300 global brands and agencies—including Burson, Delta Air Lines, Google, LVMH, Nestlé, and Sephora—CreatorIQ unifies creator marketing across paid, owned, earned, commerce, and community into one seamless, enterprise-grade ecosystem. With industry-leading intelligence infrastructure, rigorous compliance and security standards, and integrations with Meta, Snapchat, TikTok, YouTube, and more, CreatorIQ empowers brands and agencies to harness the creator economy as a strategic growth engine. CreatorIQ is a global company headquartered in Los Angeles with offices in Austin, New York, San Francisco, London, Manila, and Warsaw. Learn more at www.creatoriq.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

At CreatorIQ, we believe that diversity is the key to unlocking our full potential. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and empowering work environment where everyone can thrive, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes us unique. By embracing our core values of being intentional, pursuing excellence every day, embracing the journey together, being a good human, and staying focused on what’s important, we create an atmosphere that promotes collaboration and growth. Join us to celebrate differences, innovate together, and be a part of a business that is disrupting the marketing industry.

Compensation, Benefits and Beyond:

We understand that a comprehensive benefits package plays a significant role in your overall compensation. To gain more insight into the various components of our total compensation, we invite you to review our benefits and perks.

AI Transparency Notice

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications and note taking during interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please refer to our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

raw.title: B2B Demand Generation Manager
raw.description:
The Role

Deliveroo is on a mission to transform the way the world thinks about food delivery, and B2B marketing is central to how we grow our merchant business. We're looking for a B2B Demand Generation Manager to own paid demand generation across our operating markets and help us win in one of the most competitive categories in tech. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role for a seasoned performance marketer who can own demand gen end-to-end — from strategy and channel mix through to creative, execution, and the leads that actually convert into live, revenue-generating merchants.

Deliveroo operates in a focused set of markets, which means local relevance is everything. You'll work hand-in-hand with country Sales and commercial teams to understand each market's strategy, adapt the demand gen playbook to local realities, and choose the channels and tactics that will move the needle in each one. Rather than running a single global template, you'll tailor your approach country by country while building the repeatable systems that let us scale what works.

You'll manage significant budgets across a broad channel mix (Meta, TikTok, Google, programmatic and beyond) and you'll be equally comfortable crafting a sharp lead-gen campaign and a brand awareness push to win back share against multiple well-funded competitors. You'll partner with creatives to shape intelligent, well-positioned campaigns and testing winners, learning with data what works and can be scaled.

What you'll be responsible for

  • Owning end-to-end paid demand generation across our markets and B2B products, managing significant budgets across a broad channel mix (Meta, TikTok, Google, programmatic and beyond), experimenting with locally relevant tactics and turning what works into scalable playbooks;

  • Partnering closely with country Sales and commercial stakeholders to understand local strategy and market dynamics, and adapting the demand gen playbook to each market;

  • Building a lead generation engine that converts, looking beyond raw lead volume to lead quality, merchants that go live, and the GOV (Gross Order Value) they generate

  • Partnering with creative on full-funnel campaigns and sharp positioning, from lead generation through to brand awareness that defends and grows share in a highly competitive category, working independently with country teams;

  • Driving automation and AI-assisted workflows to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort;

  • Supporting new product and feature launches with go-to-market demand generation campaigns;

  • Owning reporting and measurement, defining success from spend through to live merchants and GOV, and building strong relationships with Sales, Product and commercial teams to drive real business impact.

What you'll be able to demonstrate

Essential

  • A seasoned performance marketer with 5–8 years running high-budget B2B paid campaigns across multiple channels with real strength in Meta, TikTok and Google Search and across multiple countries, products or clients;

  • SMB B2B experience: you build lead generation pipelines that convert, thinking beyond the lead to good leads, merchants that go live, and the GOV they generate;

  • Strong local and commercial instinct: you work naturally with Sales, adapt to each country's strategy, and communicate clearly in English (other languages a plus);

  • Ability to plan and optimise media investment against business and campaign-level KPIs, and to do in-house media buying;

  • A spark of creativity and a sharp eye for positioning, you partner with creatives to craft intelligent campaigns and operate independently with country teams;

  • Analytical and data-driven: you define KPIs, form hypotheses, design tests for statistically significant results, and scale up what works;

  • Genuine interest in using AI and automation to improve how you work, with concrete examples to back it up.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with the Food or Retail industries;

  • Experience aligning inbound and outbound motions, and knowledge of data enrichment and attribution (e.g. Clay, Cognism, ZoomInfo), ABM or intent-based tools;

  • Experience with content syndication, paid PR or retail media.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

raw.title: Commercial & Strategy Manager
raw.description:
Commercial & Startegy Manager - Milton Keynes & Northampton

 

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.

We’re looking for a Commercial City Manager to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us build relationships with restaurant partners across Milton Keynes & Northampton, using data-driven insights to improve our customer proposition and accelerate local growth.

Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect. https://careers.deliveroo.co.uk/the-commercial-team/

 

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Regional Growth team. We are responsible for the commercial output of our mid-market restaurant partners across the UK and Ireland, focusing on bringing the best local selection to our customers and unlocking growth opportunities for our restaurants.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Act as Local Expert: Serve as the face of Deliveroo for Milton Keynes & Northampton, mapping out local sales strategies to close value proposition gaps and improve customer selection.

  • Manage Top Restaurant Partnerships: Lead account management and commercial negotiations for key partners, optimising their operational and platform performance for growth.

  • Drive Data-Led Insights: Analyse restaurant and area performance metrics neighbourhood by neighbourhood to refine the customer offering and guide strategic decisions.

  • Acquire and Onboard Top Local Brands: Identify, pitch, and sign up local favourite restaurants to Deliveroo, setting them up for long-term commercial success.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with local Account Managers, Operations, and Marketing teams to support local hero brands and maximize marketing campaign participation.

 

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Commercial & Relationship Management: Proven experience in account management, sales, or strategy roles with a target-oriented mindset.

  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Strong capability to interpret area performance metrics and restaurant data to uncover growth opportunities and make strategic improvements.

  • Negotiation & Stakeholder Leadership: Ability to manage complex commercial conversations and build long-lasting relationships with restaurant partners.

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer
raw.description:
About the team

Engineering the future of customer support — at global scale 🌍

We believe exceptional customer service is more than just a feature, it’s a fundamental part of who we are. That’s why we’ve built our own internal support tooling from the ground up, tailored to help our customer, courier, and merchant support teams shine in every interaction.

As we scale our operations from 30 to 60 countries, supporting millions of users and partners, our internal tools need to scale with us. The Support Engineering group is at the heart of this mission. We build high-performance admin applications and core operational tools that empower our support teams to work smarter and faster. A key part of this is our in-house chat platform, which already handles around 5 million conversations every month. On top of this foundation, we’re developing advanced features to reduce manual work, improve communication, and proactively resolve issues — often before our users even notice them.

Our systems range from automated reach-outs for delayed orders to deeply integrated tools that enable our support teams to deliver assistance quickly, reliably, and with a human touch. By removing inefficiencies and automating repetitive tasks, we’re ensuring that our users and partners receive world-class support at scale.

 

About the role

We’re now looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) to join us in building scalable, low-latency systems that power these tools and shape the future of customer support. You’ll work on impactful products that directly influence how millions of people experience our platform every day.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and maintain high-throughput backend services using Go.

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and frontend developers to ship features that support internal support agents across the globe.

  • Design systems that are scalable, resilient, and easy to maintain.

  • Lead and contribute to architectural discussions and technical decision-making.

  • Write well-tested code and help the team maintain high code quality standards.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and scaling complex systems.

  • 2+ years of production experience in Golang, with the ability to mentor others and drive best practices across the team.

  • Strong hands-on experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases — especially Cassandra.

  • Solid understanding of designing and operating low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems.

  • Previous on-call experience, with a pragmatic approach to reliability and incident management.

Nice to have

  • Background in Node.js or other backend languages.

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) and event-driven architectures.

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. We recognise that some candidates may require adjustments to apply for a position or fairly participate in the interview process. If you require any adjustments, please don't hesitate to let us know. We will make every effort to provide the necessary adjustments to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

Our systems range from automated reach-outs for delayed orders to deeply integrated tools that enable our support teams to deliver assistance quickly, reliably, and with a human touch. By removing inefficiencies and automating repetitive tasks, we’re ensuring that our users and partners receive world-class support at scale.

We’re now looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) to join us in building scalable, low-latency systems that power these tools and shape the future of customer support. You’ll work on impactful products that directly influence how millions of people experience our platform every day.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and maintain high-throughput backend services using Go.

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and frontend developers to ship features that support internal support agents across the globe.

  • Design systems that are scalable, resilient, and easy to maintain.

  • Lead and contribute to architectural discussions and technical decision-making.

  • Write well-tested code and help the team maintain high code quality standards.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and scaling complex systems.

  • 2+ years of production experience in Golang, with the ability to mentor others and drive best practices across the team.

  • Strong hands-on experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases — especially Cassandra.

  • Solid understanding of designing and operating low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems.

  • Previous on-call experience, with a pragmatic approach to reliability and incident management.

Nice to have

  • Background in Node.js or other backend languages.

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) and event-driven architectures.

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. Workplace & Benefits

Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity

raw.title: SMB Operations Support Manager
raw.description:
The Role

As an Operations Manager for our Operational Support team, you will lead the design and delivery of large-scale programmes across the SMB Hub — from structured engagement frameworks to communications and change initiatives — that keep the Hub's commercial priorities moving and measurable. As an Ops Support Manager, you will work closely with Sales, New Partner Experience (NMX), Account Management and Partner Support leads to ensure the right initiatives land at the right time, applying a recognised delivery methodology to keep programmes on track.

Based in Manchester and reporting to the Head of Operational Support, SMB Hub, this is an ideal role for an individual with strong project and time management skills who can manage multiple concurrent programmes end-to-end, while also designing long-term frameworks that drive lasting change across a large, fast-moving operation.

The Team

The SMB Hub brings together our commercial teams — Sales, New Partner Experience (NPX), Account Management and Partner Support — responsible for Deliveroo's relationships with thousands of independent restaurant and retail partners across Europe, supported through our in-house contact centre in Manchester and third-party providers.

The Operational Support team is the glue that holds the Hub together. Within the team, we own workforce management (WFM), commercial excellence, tooling and automation — and this role is central to delivering change, ensuring effective communication throughout the Hub, and driving commercial excellence for our partners and the Hub as a whole.

Core Responsibilities

Programme & Change Management

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale SMB initiatives — from scoping and governance through to sign-off, communications and reporting — so senior teams can track commercial impact.

  • Apply a consistent, recognised methodology (PRINCE2 or Six Sigma) to give initiatives clear milestones, risk management and quality control.

  • Design and embed a structured engagement framework for the Hub, defining how initiatives are prioritised, resourced and measured.

Strategic Planning

  • Translate Hub priorities into actionable delivery plans that support commercial objectives, such as Ad revenue growth and partner adoption of Ads and Offers.

  • Monitor delivery and engagement metrics (e.g. Peakon, adoption rates) and use the insight to adjust plans, manage risk and support decision-making.

  • Collaborate with senior leadership across Sales, NMX and Account Management to align delivery capacity with Hub priorities.

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Own the SMB communications strategy — channel ownership, sequencing and accountability — to improve clarity and consistency of key messages.

  • Produce clear, structured reporting that translates operational detail into decisions for senior stakeholders.

  • Act as the conduit between Sales, NPX, Account Management, Partner Support and Ops, keeping a wide stakeholder group aligned and informed.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Leading delivery of the Hub's structured engagement framework, defining how initiatives are prioritised and measured.

  • Designing and implementing strategic communications and change initiatives, ensuring cross-functional alignment and coaching teams to embed new ways of working.

  • Applying PRINCE2 or Six Sigma to bring rigour, clear milestones and risk management to SMB programmes.

  • Delivering the Hub's career pathway and capability-building initiatives, connecting development and learning to progression.

  • Championing change and identifying new ways of working with Sales, NPX and Account Management to ensure agents have the right tools and content.

  • Partnering with the commercial excellence and central teams to build robust plans that drive change through better engagement, improved efficiency or increased capability.

  • Linking delivery directly to commercial outcomes, such as Ad revenue growth and partner adoption of Ads and Offers.

  • Identifying risks and inconsistencies before they affect delivery, escalating and problem-solving with appropriate autonomy.

What You'll Need to Thrive

This is a delivery-focused role that will require an individual who can manage a number of competing priorities across a live, fast-moving Hub while keeping sight of the bigger picture. The successful candidate will be structured, comfortable applying a recognised delivery methodology, and confident communicating with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.

The required skills include:

  • Strong project and programme management skills, ideally with a PRINCE2 or Six Sigma qualification (or clear demonstrable working knowledge)

  • Excellent time management — able to prioritise, sequence and protect delivery quality across multiple workstreams

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to flex style for different audiences, including senior stakeholders

  • Proven ability to lead and deliver complex plans against deadlines, with a clear prioritisation model

  • Comfortable working with data and metrics to track and evidence impact, not just activity

  • A collaborative approach; able to bring the right people together across functions and build trust quickly

The desired experiences include:

  • Typically 3+ years' experience in project or programme delivery, operations, or a comparable environment

  • Is either Six Sigma or Prince2 methodology (or equivalent) certified (Preferred)

  • Experience delivering communications, engagement or change initiatives at scale

  • Experience working within a commercial or contact-centre operating environment

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine — our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. boarded onto the platform. This role is important to ensuring we continue to grow and enable

raw.title: Onboarding Specialist, EMEA
raw.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey is scaling a global, fast-growing workforce, and our onboarding program needs to move from operational execution to strategic program design. Today we can reliably run onboarding. What we need next is someone who can build the curriculum, facilitator infrastructure, and scalable systems that let onboarding hold up as we open new markets.

This hire does two jobs at once: (1) contributes to the design of a global onboarding curriculum, and (2) owns EMEA facilitation as their home region. The dual mandate is intentional. We want a builder who also stays close to the live cohort experience, so global program decisions are grounded in what actually happens in the room.

This is a growth role. It expands onboarding capacity in EMEA and adds dedicated curriculum and program-design horsepower that the team does not currently have in-region.

What You'll Do

Global Program and Curriculum Design (contributing)

  • Support onboarding learning design: translate content into structured curriculum and checklists with clear learning objectives, sequencing, and outcomes.

  • Build facilitator playbooks and train-the-trainer materials so new facilitators can run onboarding consistently as Harvey opens new markets.

  • Support implementation and organization of onboarding materials in the LMS.

  • Support design of differentiated onboarding journeys for distinct populations (e.g., executive leadership, remote and distributed hires).

  • Support operational automations that strengthen the program's foundation and make it scalable.

EMEA Facilitation (owning)

  • Own EMEA onboarding facilitation: run orientation for EMEA cohorts and make every new hire feel welcomed and confident that Harvey was the right career choice from day one.

  • Bring the EMEA regional lens into global program design: flag where the global curriculum needs local adaptation (compliance, culture, time zones, market maturity).

Stakeholder Management and Continuous Improvement (owning)

  • Partner cross-functionally with Recruiting, Legal, L&D, and Enablement to deliver a world-class onboarding experience.

  • Create, iterate, and maintain core onboarding curriculum and materials (orientation content, facilitator guides, and Notion documentation), keeping them accurate as the program evolves.

  • Collect and act on new-hire and facilitator feedback to iterate on curriculum and close program gaps.

  • Support EMEA-relevant onboarding automation (email sequences, calendar workflows), flag issues, and suggest system improvements.


What You Have

Must Have

  • 2-4+ years in People Ops, L&D, Enablement, Onboarding, or a related instructional design/facilitation role, with demonstrated curriculum ownership (not pure coordination).

  • Hands-on instructional and curriculum design: building learning content for global audiences grounded in adult learning principles.

  • Comfort adapting learning materials into LMS modules.

  • Strong stakeholder management: proven collaboration across functions (Recruiting, Finance, Legal, People Ops, Enablement) to build learning programming.

  • Confident, engaging facilitator able to own a room across audiences, including executive leadership and large cohorts.

  • Data-informed approach: uses new-hire and facilitator feedback to drive iteration.

  • High attention to detail and strong follow-through in a fast-paced startup environment.

Nice to Have

  • Launching or scaling onboarding programs in new markets or geographies.

  • Train-the-trainer methodology: building facilitator guides or playbooks others can pick up and run.

  • Building operational automations.

  • Prior startup or high-growth experience.

  • Exposure to global HR operations or multi-entity environments.

  • HRIS experience (Workday or Deel strongly preferred) plus comfort with onboarding workflows, operations, and systems.

  • Excellent drafting and negotiation skills, with the confidence to represent Harvey on matters relating to data privacy, AI, and security

What You'll Do

  • Assist in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating Data Processing Agreements with our customers, subprocessors, service providers, and third-parties.

  • Help develop, maintain, and scale global privacy programs. This includes preparing Data Protection Impact Assessments to identify and mitigate privacy risks and Records of Processing in accordance with regulatory requirements.

  • Work cross functionally with talented product and engineering teams in evaluating the impact of privacy and data protection laws and regulatory guidance on exciting product developments.

  • Monitor and respond to changes in privacy laws and regulations, including AI regulations.

  • Support implementation and ongoing compliance with AI-specific regulation, including the EU AI Act, UK AI governance frameworks, and related guidance.

  • Assist in classification of AI systems, assessment of risk obligations, and development of internal AI governance controls, documentation, and processes.

  • Partner with legal, product, and compliance stakeholders on AI principles such as transparency, accountability, and human-oversight.


What You Have

  • Qualified lawyer with 4+ years of post-qualification experience in privacy and data protection

  • Proven expertise in EU and U.S. data protection law, with familiarity across global compliance frameworks

  • Excellent drafting and negotiation skills, with the confidence to represent Harvey on matters relating to data privacy, AI, and security

  • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across legal and business teams

  • Highly responsive and detail-oriented, with the ability to balance strategic thinking and hands-on execution

raw.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.


Role Overview

As a Customer Experience Specialist, you will be the frontline support within the Customer Experience team, reporting to the CX Manager. Your role is crucial in providing empathetic and efficient support to our customers. We are seeking someone who loves problem-solving, is adept at handling multiple priorities, and is passionate about working with enterprise customers to ensure a seamless support experience.

This role follows a fixed Wednesday-Sunday schedule, with weekend coverage included as part of the standard five-day workweek.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer support inquiries, delivering empathetic, accurate, and timely resolutions across a range of technical and product-related issues (including AI output quality, app access, APIs, authentication, and error logs).

  • Manage multiple competing priorities while maintaining a high level of responsiveness, reliability, and accountability during assigned support shifts.

  • Collaborate effectively with teammates and cross-functional partners to troubleshoot complex issues, escalate when appropriate, and contribute to a strong overall customer experience.

  • Maintain deep, up-to-date knowledge of products, features, and services to provide informed, current support.

  • Own tasks independently while contributing thoughtfully to team workflows and the ongoing refinement of support processes.

 

What We Offer

  • Structured hybrid working arrangement: 3 days in office, 2 days working from home

  • A comprehensive 4-week onboarding and training program designed to set you up for success from day one

  • Professional development stipend to support your continued learning and growth

  • Opportunities to work on cross-functional projects and initiatives that impact user operations company-wide

  • Be part of building something special as we continue to build support operations at Harvey

 

What You Have

  • 3+ years of proven experience in a fast-paced technical support role, delivering white-glove or premium support to large enterprise customers for AI-driven products.

  • Exceptional empathy and communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to build trust, connect with customers, and clearly explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities, with a creative approach to diagnosing and resolving complex issues.
    Highly organised and adaptable, able to manage multiple tasks and competing priorities effectively.

  • Solid understanding of APIs, with the ability to troubleshoot and articulate API-related concepts clearly.

  • Proficiency with customer support tools and CRM systems.

  • Collaborative team player who builds positive cross-functional relationships while contributing effectively in a shared environment.

raw.title: Senior Product Manager - Storage & Networking
raw.description:
About our team:

Radiant is at the forefront of AI infrastructure, revolutionising the connection between software and hardware for the AI era. Our mission is to empower AI teams with scalable, secure, and efficient infrastructure solutions that support seamless model training, deployment, and scaling.

Join a team operating some of the world’s most advanced high-performance computing infrastructure. As a Cloud Support Engineer, you will support cutting-edge GPU and CPU platforms — including the latest NVIDIA architectures — powering dense, large-scale compute environments used for AI, machine learning, and next-generation workloads.

This is an opportunity to build expertise at the forefront of modern infrastructure, where reliability, scale, and performance matter every day. You’ll collaborate with experienced engineers across a globally distributed organisation that values openness, inclusion, technical excellence, and continuous learning.

We move quickly, solve meaningful challenges, and give people the space to make an impact. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy working with advanced technology, and want to help shape the future of high-performance compute, you’ll find both challenge and opportunity here.

Job Summary:

As a Senior/Principal Product Manager – Storage & Networking, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of the storage and networking capabilities underpinning Radiant’s GPU platform.

You’ll work across bare-metal GPU clusters, Kubernetes, high-performance storage, data-centre networking, infrastructure inventory, automation, and observability, partnering closely with engineering, SRE, infrastructure, networking, and operations.

This is a highly technical product role focused on ensuring GPU workloads have reliable, high-throughput, low-latency infrastructure at scale.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery for storage and networking capabilities across the GPU platform.

  • Define and prioritise storage capabilities based on customer, workload, performance, scale, and operational needs.

  • Define and prioritise networking capabilities across the platform, from data centre infrastructure through to customer and workload connectivity.

  • Partner with engineering to turn requirements into scalable, reliable platform services.

  • Drive improvements in automation, self-service, observability, and operational efficiency.

  • Define success metrics and use them to guide performance, reliability, capacity, and investment decisions.

Qualifications:

  • Experience owning technical infrastructure, platform, storage, networking, or cloud products end-to-end.

  • Experience working in data centre, bare-metal, cloud, HPC, AI infrastructure, or similar environments.

  • Good understanding of modern storage technologies and architectures, and familiarity with file, object and block storage, WEKA, VAST, DDN, or similar.

  • Good understanding of modern data centre and high-performance networking technologies, with familiarity with technologies such as Ethernet, InfiniBand, RDMA, BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, and modern switching platforms.

  • Familiarity with how storage and networking integrate with Kubernetes, bare-metal infrastructure, and large-scale compute platforms.

  • Comfortable working closely with specialist engineers and making informed product and technical trade-offs.

  • Strong prioritisation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Comfortable taking ambiguous infrastructure problems from discovery through to delivery.

What you bring:

  • Systems thinking: Understand how compute, storage, networking, and platform services fit together.

  • Product thinking: Turn infrastructure capabilities into clear, scalable services for customers and internal teams.

  • Technical fluency: Work credibly with engineering without needing to be the domain expert.

  • Prioritisation: Balance customer needs, performance, reliability, cost, and complexity.

  • Ownership: Drive problems from discovery through delivery and adoption.

Our values:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change

  • You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, and Solutions teams to turn complex technical concepts into clear, accurate, practical documentation across APIs, infrastructure, platform services, integrations, and operational workflows.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable getting close to the technology, testing.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own and evolve Radiant’s developer and product documentation, including guides, tutorials, API documentation, reference material, troubleshooting guides, and operational content.

  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to ensure documentation is included as part of the product development and release process.

  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, concise, and accessible content for different technical audiences.

  • Create and maintain getting-started guides, how-to content, examples, architecture explanations, and best-practice documentation.

  • Test documented workflows directly to ensure content is accurate, complete, and usable.

  • Improve the structure, navigation, discoverability, and consistency of Radiant’s documentation.

  • Partner with Support and Solutions teams to identify common customer issues and turn them into better documentation and self-service content.

  • Establish documentation standards, templates, style guidelines, and processes that help engineering teams contribute effectively.

  • Track documentation quality and usage, using feedback and product data to continuously improve the experience.

Qualifications:

  • Experience writing documentation for technical products, cloud platforms, developer tools, infrastructure, APIs, or SaaS products.

  • Strong technical fluency and the ability to understand concepts across:

    • Cloud & infrastructure: Kubernetes, containers, networking, compute, storage

    • APIs & integrations: REST APIs, authentication, webhooks, SDKs

    • Developer workflows: CLI tools, Git, CI/CD, configuration and automation

    • Observability & operations: logging, metrics, monitoring and troubleshooting

  • Comfortable reading code, API specifications, configuration files, architecture diagrams, and technical designs.

  • Experience with docs-as-code workflows, Markdown, Git, and documentation tooling such as Docusaurus, MkDocs, GitBook, ReadMe, or similar.

  • Able to work directly with engineers and subject matter experts to extract the information needed without relying on fully formed source material.

  • Excellent written communication, editing, information architecture, and attention to detail.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where products and documentation evolve quickly.

What you bring:

  • Systems thinking: Understand how infrastructure, services, data, and operational workflows fit together.

  • Product thinking: Treat internal teams as customers and focus on measurable outcomes.

  • Technical fluency: Able to work credibly across APIs, integrations, infrastructure, data, and architecture.

  • Prioritisation: Balance operational pain, strategic value, technical complexity, and business impact.

  • Ownership: Drive ambiguous problems from discovery and definition through to adoption and iteration.

Our values:

Senior Risk Manager
raw.description:
Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth.

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love. Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success.

Over the past few years, our client base has grown 20 times to over 4 million, and client assets have grown over 50 times to over €5 billion.

Role Overview

The Senior Risk Manager will play a crucial role in supporting the business to embed the Risk Management Framework and manage and mitigate risks across the organisation. You will be responsible for liaising with the first line of defence to support them in identifying and understanding their risk profile, assessing the design and effectiveness of controls and procedures, ensuring these align with internal policies. This role requires a deep understanding of financial markets, trading practices, and global best practices for risk management frameworks.

What you’ll do

  • Ensure the organisation’s approach to the management of risk is aligned with its risk appetite and strategy.

  • Facilitate delivery and maintenance of Risk and Control Risk Assessments (RCSAs), ensuring appropriate oversight of risk identification, assessment and treatment are performed in line with risk appetite.

  • Perform periodic independent second line of defence assurance through the delivery of individual controls testing and thematic assurance reviews.

  • Identify gaps in the control environment and work with the first line of defence to determine remediation plans, ensuring progress is tracked and reported on through governance.

  • Deliver Top-Down Risk Assessments through engaging with senior management and subject matter experts to identify material risks the Firm are exposed to.

  • Maintenance of the legal entity Risk Register and overseeing the maintenance of thematic Risk Registers, including the Fraud Risk Register, Market Abuse Risk Register and Business Wide Financial Crime Risk Assessment.

  • Participating in the ICARA process, ensuring all relevant risks are captured, quantified and adequately stressed.

  • Providing oversight of risk events by working with first line colleagues to understand the root cause of events, their impact on the Firm and what corrective and preventive actions are required to remediate.

  • Demonstrating a solid understanding of liquidity risk management.

  • Delivering coherent, transparent and rigorous risk governance reporting.

  • Delivery of Risk projects to develop, evolve and enhance both the design and embeddedness of the Firm’s Risk Management Framework and supporting processes.

  • Provide an overview and challenge of the trading risk to which the firm is exposed.

  • Ensure appropriate horizon scanning processes are implemented to identify and manage emerging risks.

  • Providing second line risk reviews for new product and feature launches, and strategic and regulatory change initiatives, ensuring risk is identified from the offset, with downstream impacts managed and aligned to risk appetite.

  • Support the identification and enhancement of both qualitative and quantitative risk appetite measures, ensuring these are tracked with any breach escalated and remediated in line with risk appetite.

  • Preparing and presenting thematic risk reports and assessments to senior management and governance bodies.

  • Fostering a healthy Risk Culture by promoting the view that risk management is a universal responsibility by encouraging open and transparent discussions without fear of retaliation.

What you need to have

  • Extensive knowledge of risk management principles and practices.

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking abilities.

  • High attention to detail and risk assessment skills.

  • Effective communication and leadership capabilities.

  • Understanding of the FCA’s MiFIDPRU framework, wind-down planning, and operational resilience

  • Financial management, particularly capital and liquidity management.

  • Management and understanding of market risk in a retail client base.

  • Ability to develop and implement risk mitigation strategies.

  • Proficiency in risk management software and tools.

  • Outsourcing/TPRM experience is good to have.

What we offer

  • Unique challenges that will help you grow and realise your potential really fast

  • Opportunity to make a big impact - you will create products used by millions of investors to build wealth

  • Work with smart, high-performing colleagues with a common goal in a flat, cross-functional team structure

  • An environment where nothing is set in stone, no bureaucracy

  • Appreciation for your talent and ideas

  • Generous remuneration package including annual bonuses

Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker!

raw.description:
Hi, we’re Bloom & Wild. We don’t just send flowers. We help our customers to care wildly. Caring wildly is celebrating the little things we all do for each other every day. Not just the big occasions. It’s being there for the highs. Stepping up for the lows.
 
We care wildly about people and our planet. Which is why we’re so proud to be a certified B Corp™ – committed to making long-term positive change for our community, and the world around us.
 
Founded in 2013, our mission back then was to make sending and receiving flowers the joy that it should be, by harnessing technology, brand and letterbox delivery. We announced £75 million Series D funding in 2021 and that same year acquired bloomon in The Netherlands and Bergamotte in France. Together, we’ve fulfilled and delivered over 20 million orders (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe.
 
Now home to a family of 3 beautiful brands, we’re driven by our vision to create the destination for making life a little more thoughtful and beautiful. And we won't stop at flowers and plants. Starting with the Bloom & Wild brand, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination. 
 
🛠️ Range Team @ Bloom & Wild Group
We're responsible for concepting, developing and launching our beautiful product ranges for all markets and platforms. What began as a range of just three bouquets of letterbox flowers, now spans an ever-evolving collection of both flowers, plants, gifts, addons and much more.

We care wildly about curating a thoughtful range of gifts that our customers will be proud to send, and love to receive. We collaborate with many teams across the business to support our ideation and decision making; from gathering customer insight and research with BI, creative design and photography with our Creative team, to unit economics with Finance, and execution with our Supply and Quality teams. 

This role reports to Lucy, our Category Lead for Flowers & Plants.

⚙️ What you'll be doing:


Shoots & Photography

  • Act as our floristry guardian - setting and maintaining our house style across all shoots

  • Leading on floral conditioning and styling for ecommerce and lifestyle shoots - helping to problem-solve and give sign-off 

  • Lead flower ordering and supplier liaison ahead of shoots, including sourcing substitutions when stems are not available

  • Co-ordinating additional support from freelance florists where required and then overseeing their work, so quality and style stay consistent whoever's on set.


    • New Product Development (NPD)

  • Help set floral seasonal direction alongside the Range and Creative teams for all horticulture ranges

  • Design and refine bouquets through our entire NPD process, including revisiting designs once stem costs are confirmed

  • Attending pre-production meetings ahead of important range launches to support decision making and help shoot plan

  • Contribute to directional planning documents such as moodboards, creative directions and floral photoshoot styling guidelines

  • Keep abreast of floral trading trends to feed into future bouquet designs and to support data based decision making on shoots.


    • Reactive & ad hoc support

  • Supporting on reactive photography needs quickly to respond to trading trends 

  • Support ad hoc florist requests across the business, from PR and brand gifting to floral styling for company events

  • Help the Brand and PR teams with adhoc floral needs, including occasional support presenting floristry tips or styling content on camera.

Sr. AV Operations Specialist, UK

Please note: this role requires full-time onsite presence in London

Location: London, South Bank/Central London (County Hall)

Salary Range: £36,000-38,000/annually + eligibility for discretionary annual bonus

Start Date: As soon as possible (within 1-2 months)

 

Convene Hospitality Group and etc.venues, a global industry leader in premium meeting, event, flexible office, and membership spaces is seeking a full-time Senior AV Operations Specialist to join our Operations team at one of our flagship etc.venues locations in Central London. The Senior AV Operations Specialist will exemplify a passion for Hospitality, Events, and AV Technology along with being a proponent of cultivating a positive and inclusive employee culture. In this role, the Senior AV Operations Specialist will partner with and report directly to the General Manager as well as the Technology Manager.

What You'll Do: 

The Senior AV Operations Specialist provides and supports all services used to deliver technology to our customers and associates including networking, desktop support, audio, video, HSIA, audio & video conferencing, webcasting, and basic lighting for a variety of corporate meetings and events. The AV Operations Specialist works closely with customers and the AV Management Team to deliver an excellent meeting, conference, and working experience. The person in this role also works directly with the property and event teams to deliver excellent client experiences.

  • Lead ad-hoc troubleshooting and assistance to customers of all technology competency levels.

  • High school diploma/GED required; Bachelor's Degree preferred
  • 4-5 years of experience in supporting AV and IT equipment and computer software systems.
  • Customer service or hospitality experience preferred.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of audiovisual equipment including analog/digital audio mixers, wireless microphone systems, seamless video switchers, and projectors/displays.
  • Possess a basic understanding of Crestron and other central control systems.
  • Basic knowledge of data networking principles, architecture, and applications.
  • Experience in the basic installation, configuration, operation and administration of operating systems, applications and hardware for Macs, PCs, LANs, and servers.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google worksuite, and Apple iWorks suite of business applications.
  • Flexible, long, and weekend hours are sometimes required.
  • Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects up to 25 pounds without assistance.
  • Ability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
  • Ability to stand, sit, or walk for an extended period.
  • Ability to climb and work on a ladder for lengthy periods.

Equipment & Technical Qualifications:

  • Audio: 4-48 channel analog/digital mixers, wireless microphone lavaliers and handhelds, push-to-talk microphone systems, audio recorders. Familiarity with Biamp Server/Forte systems is a plus.
  • Video: Switchers, projectors, LCD displays, LED Video Walls, Media Server familiarity a plus
  • Lighting: Knowledge of Lighting Maps, lighting concepts, and lighting best practices, familiarity with rigging.

  • Hybrid: Familiarity with virtual meeting and event platform functions as well as live streaming technologies including cameras, encoders, lighting, and transmission protocols i.e. RTMPs/HLS/SRT.

raw.title: Senior Product Manager - Charging & Tax
raw.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

About the team:

Charging turns products (tariffs), energy usage and tax into the correct charges on every bill. This role owns Charging with a strong tax focus: how tax and exemptions are configured, when and where tax is applied (per-transaction versus per-bill-document) and how charge and tax data feeds finance reporting and ERP. You own the problem end to end. Clients should be able to configure their own tax rules, launch confidently in new markets and trust the data that flows into their ERP without carrying compliance risk themselves.

You will work closely with clients but also the compliance partners and lead the Charging product area as a senior individual contributor, owning the vision and roadmap and working directly with the Charging engineering team.

Primary Responsibilities:

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Own the Charging product vision and roadmap with tax as a first-class topic. Set the long-term direction, map the dependencies and design for the different cases

  • Drive the shift to client self-service, so clients can set up products, charges, tax and exemptions without developer intervention

  • Reduce manual intervention and lower cost to serve for our clients

  • Own the tax calculation approach including third-party coordination and define the requirements for accruals, future cost estimation and cost-of-usage so the platform gives an accurate cost picture

  • Cross-Domain Integration & Alignment

  • Understand how charging, issuance, cost calculation, ledger and ERP interact and own charging and tax as a coherent part

  • Define the tax and charge reporting requirements into finance integration

  • Lead trade-off discussions across Billing, Payments and Debt and communicating decisions clearly

  • Bring problems and requirements to engineering and leave the solution space to them, engaging the right teams early without creating bottlenecks

Market Expansion & Discovery

  • Be the voice of the client for charging and tax to understand what each market requires

  • Make sure new tax configurations and markets are supported through the core, not one-off custom builds

Key Success Metrics & Outcomes:

Your success is measured by billing accuracy, the share of charging and tax changes clients can make themselves, the range of markets supported through the core and clean compliance outcomes.

Accuracy & Operational Success

  • No misbilling incidents attributable to charging or tax

  • Higher share of product, charge and tax changes made by clients without developer involvement. For clients it means they can update a tax rate or add a tax exemption themselves, without waiting for Kraken

Compliance & Coverage

  • Clean audit and regulation outcomes on charge and tax output and correct on-time tax reporting into ERP. For clients that means their finance teams close month-end without manual tax reconciliation - so that when regulation changes Kraken reflects it and clients aren't carrying that risk

  • Charging and tax are not the blocker on client upgrades

What You'll Need:

  • Highly capable individual contributor who wants to be the domain owner for charging and tax

  • 5+ years in product management, ideally in financial, billing or tax systems, owning a complex backend area end to end

  • Hands-on experience with taxation in a product or systems context: configuration, exemptions, cross-jurisdiction rules and the difference between transaction-level and document-level tax. You do not need to be an expert in every utility market, but you are confident driving tax decisions and talking to regulations and compliance teams

  • Systems thinking across charging, issuance, cost calculation, ledger and ERP, reasoning about dependencies and edge cases rather than the happy path alone

  • A track record of turning regulatory and finance requirements into product without being prescriptive about the engineering implementation

  • Advanced AI fluency. You use AI hands-on to explore problems, stress-test decisions and move faster

  • Strong written communication, anchoring decisions in evidence and presenting options with tradeoffs

  • Fluency in English is required

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Growth marketing strategist: You treat marketing spend as a portfolio of investments, not a cost center. You can decompose a blended CAC, trace attribution across channels, build cohort-level payback models, and tell a CMO exactly where the next marginal dollar should go and where to cut. Technical and data-driven: Strong analytical skills, with expert Excel modeling skills as table stakes. Comfortable with data (SQL, HEX, BI tools, or equivalent). You use AI tools and agents to automate work and move faster. Preference for technical degrees or deep technical exposure.

Service-first partner: You bring a proactive, "can-do" attitude to every interaction and own the operationally tedious work required for clean handoffs between teams.

High-slope learner: You learn faster than anyone around you, take ownership immediately, and thrive in low-structure environments. You go from 0→1 and then 1→10.

Experience: 4+ years of relevant experience supporting Marketing leadership. Strong candidates have a foundation in investment banking, private equity, venture capital, or management consulting, combined with operational experience at a high-growth startup, AI company, or scaled technology company. You learn fast, take ownership, and operate well in environments where the playbook doesn't exist yet. Bachelor's degree required.

What You’ll Do

Drive marketing efficiency & planning: Own the financial operating plan for Marketing - budget allocation, campaign ROI analysis, and investment tradeoffs to fuel B2C growth while maintaining unit economics discipline.

Build and own channel-level unit economics: Develop and own the CAC, LTV, and payback models that drive investment decisions at the channel and cohort level. Tie spend to acquisition, retention, and revenue so that marketing leadership and finance are operating from one shared source of truth. Pressure-test assumptions continuously — what's working, what's not, and where the next dollar should go.
